verdict.rationale: Auto-enrichment is a fair question for a CRM, but nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic firmographic or contact enrichment of records. The closest items are developer building blocks: REST APIs, functions that fetch third-party data, and workflows that update fields. These could be used to construct enrichment but are not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
